products.name: Group Travel ERP
products.description: The GRIP-style back office for group and coach tour operators: product management for fixed-date departures and series, CRM, booking desk, invoicing and payments, process management and quality in one system, plus the group-operations depth the segment needs - capacity and minimum-participant yielding, bus seat allocation, hotel room lists, guide assignment and passenger lists. Sold as a monthly subscription (published base package from EUR 129 per month) extended with modules and portals.

products.name: Tailor-Made Travel Suite
products.description: The TravelSpirit-style modular back office for tailor-made specialists and DMCs: CRM with integrated email and telephony, workflow, travel plans and stored components, orders and trip files, MediaSpirit photo management, invoicing and documents, together with the Visual Tour Builder that turns a travel wish into a day-by-day visual online proposal the client can approve and pay. Start package for small operators, enterprise contract for larger ones.

products.name: Online Booking Websites and CMS
products.description: Real-time bookable customer websites under the operator's own brand (1TIS Klantwebsite, TravelSpirit SPoE Single Point of Entry) driven directly from the back-office product, availability, pricing and content data, with a CMS for pages and campaigns, online checkout with deposit payment and immediate booking-file creation - no re-keying between web and desk.

products.name: Traveler Portal and My-Trip App
products.description: The traveler's personal booking pages (booking inzien) and my-trip experience: approve quotes, pay open amounts, share passenger details, wishes and dietary requirements, download travel documents and itineraries, and travel with the operator-branded partner apps (Travelia, Appit) including in-trip information, Hubby eSIM offers, aftercare surveys and Trustpilot reviews.

products.name: Supplier, DMC, Reseller and Guide Portals
products.description: The trade-facing portals that hang off the ERP: a supplier and DMC approval portal for one-to-one service requests, confirmations, room lists and passenger details; a reseller and agent portal (including independent ZRA-style agents) for booking the operator's products and retrieving documents; and group-leader and tour-guide portals with participant lists, seating and daily programmes.

products.name: Finance, Payments and Compliance
products.description: The finance and accounting attach: invoicing, payment links and alerts (Mollie), accounts receivable and payable, supplier settlement, accounting integration and electronic invoicing (Exact), IATA HOT and Airtrade flight settlement files, and travel-guarantee-fund and package-travel-regulation reporting so month-end closes without spreadsheets.

products.name: Marketing and Business Intelligence
products.description: Marketing and steering on top of the integrated data model: CRM segmentation and consent, email campaigns (Spotler), review collection (Trustpilot), and business-intelligence dashboards and exports (Travel Intelligence) covering bookings, margin, online share, forecast and KPI steering for the business owner.

products.name: AI Travel Office Assistant
products.description: Embedded AI assistants for the travel office, the Vortex thesis of AI inside the ERP: drafting visual proposals from a travel wish and stored components, triaging the shared inbox into booking-file actions, suggesting answers to customer questions from the booking view, and pre-filling supplier requests - always under human review.
